versions.changelog: Listing examples now pass validation (description 40 to 500 characters). Documents listingSkipped when the daily listing limit is reached, the real rate limits, and that keyless callers can sell with X-Payout-Address.

API moves to api.payaion.com (the old host keeps answering). New: take a listing down with DELETE /v1/aion/marketplace/{uploadId}; the file and existing buyers' access stay. New API keys start with pya_; av_ keys keep working.

Storage folders. Five REST calls to list storage, create, rename or move a folder, delete one, and file an upload into it. Folders are metadata: a move never touches the file, and deleting a folder keeps every file inside it — they drop back to the storage root with their share link, price and expiry unchanged. Nesting stops at 8 levels; a key is required.
Keyless selling is documented end to end: X-Payout-Address on the upload routes, the /m/ market link, and the 95/5 split.

Share links and market pages are now separate: downloadUrl is always /d/<hash> (the direct link you send someone), and url is the market listing page /m/<hash>, present only when the file is listed. Previously one URL did both jobs and switched appearance under the recipient once a price or listing was added. The final report now shows both links separately.

Transfers no longer need an API key: omit X-Aion-Key and the upload runs as a guest (100 MB, 24-hour link, no account). A key raises the limits and is still required to list or buy. Also drops PAYAION_API_KEY from openclaw.requires, which had been hiding the skill from agents that had not set one.

Corrects the marketplace listing title limit and refreshes links.

- Listing title is 3-120 characters, not 3-24. The old figure was never enforced anywhere — the API, the web validator and the UI all allow 120 — so agents were truncating or rejecting valid titles.
- Plans and pricing now link to payaion.com/pricing; the docs section that link used to point at has been folded away.
- Storage limits confirmed against the live plan table: Basic 500 MB per file / 2 GB total, Pro 1 GB / 20 GB. (The 1.0.0 changelog quoted 5 GB and 50 GB — that was wrong; the skill body has always been correct.)

First Payaion release, succeeding agentvee-transfer (600+ downloads during the testnet phase).

- Production endpoints: payaion-api.fly.dev and payaion.com
- Base mainnet with live USDC pricing instead of testnet
- PAYAION_API_KEY replaces AGENTVEE_API_KEY
- Plan-aware limits: 500 MB per file / 5 GB total on Basic, 1 GB / 50 GB on Pro
- Full error table: storage_limit_exceeded, size_limit_exceeded, wallet_required, insufficient_scope
- Correct rate limits and the 202 wait-unavailable path, the only case where polling is allowed
- Marketplace listing rules: title 3-24 chars, description 40-500 chars (required)
